text: dsh-pull-to-send 是面向 DSH 网页端的输入框拖拽发送插件：从 composer 向上拖动并在对话区域内松手即可触发当前发送按钮，同时以动画展示消息飞入气泡。拖回输入框、拖出可投放范围或按 Escape 会取消；触屏不触发，草稿为空时不会启动。它适合希望用鼠标或笔快速发送消息的网页端用户。插件没有声明 API 密钥或外部服务配置。

dsh-pull-to-send lets DSH web users send by pulling the composer upward and releasing in the conversation area. It activates the send control and animates the message into its bubble. Drag back, leave the drop area, or press Escape to cancel. Touch is ignored; empty drafts do not trigger sending.
想用鼠标从 DSH 输入框向上拖一下就发送消息
DSH 网页版能不能把拖动输入框当作发送手势？
发送前拖错了，希望拖回输入框就取消，不要发出去
dsh-pull-to-send 的功能「上拉发送」：在网页端 composer 卡片上按下后向上越过触发距离，松手且落在对话可投放区域内，会点击当前可用的发送控件；浮起的输入框副本以动画飞向新消息气泡。
dsh-pull-to-send 的功能「拖动取消」：手势武装后把指针拖回 composer 可解除武装并保留草稿；拖出投放区域、按 Escape 或失去指针则取消，不触发发送。

dsh-pull-to-send README · PULLTOSEND：按住 DSH 输入框、向上拉、松手 —— 消息飞出去。不松手可以拖回来取消，拖出对话区同样作废。

三次拖拽，把发送变成肌肉记忆：

- **拖出去发送** —— 从输入框向上拉，消息拎在半空，松手即飞。
- **拖回来取消** —— 反悔了就把指针拖回输入框，一切归位，草稿还在。
- **拖出界取消** —— 甩到屏幕边缘、任务栏或别的窗口上，直接作废，绝不误发。

dsh-pull-to-send README · 安装：```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "github:dhdkfkfkf/dsh-pull-to-send"
```

装完重启一次 DSH（添加 bundle 本身需要重启；之后改代码走 dsh-hmr 热更）。

dsh-pull-to-send README · 三种拖拽：| 你做什么 | 会发生什么 |
| --- | --- |
| **拖出去**：在输入框卡片（含周边 12px 缓冲区）上按下，向上拉出卡片上边缘 **≥24px** | 武装：输入框副本被拎起，跟随指针（阻尼跟随、微放大、阴影加深），真输入框缩小变暗；悬停时是 grab 光标，拖动中全程 grabbing |
| 武装后**松手** | 触发发送按钮当前的主行为（空闲=发送，生成中=排队/插话），副本 FLIP 飞入新消息气泡，真气泡交叉淡入 |
| **拖回来**：武装后把指针拖回输入框卡片内 | 解除武装：副本 150ms 短回位消失，卡片恢复正常，草稿原样保留；同一按压里再拉出去可以重新武装，可反复反悔 |
| **拖出界**：武装后把指针拖出对话区可投放范围 | 立即取消：副本当场沿原路弹回消失，光标恢复，本次按压作废，松手不会发出任何东西，必须重新从输入框起手 |
| 未拉出阈值 / 横向拖拽占优 / 松手时指针停在卡片内 / 按 Esc / pointercancel | 取消：副本沿原路 320ms 弹回 |

dsh-pull-to-send README · 可投放范围：拖出去的落点必须落在这块范围里，才算一次有效的发送：

| 边界 | 位置 |
| --- | --- |
| 左边 | 输入框卡片的左缘 |
| 右边 | 对话区背景的右缘 |
| 上边 | 对话区顶格 |
| 下边 | 输入框卡片的顶缘 |

范围之外一律判为取消 —— 屏幕边缘、任务栏、别的应用程序上都算。为了让「贴着屏幕边」也能被识别为越界，右边界还额外内缩了 8px 的安全余量。

界面全程零文字提示，只靠视觉反馈：副本拎起即为武装。

dsh-pull-to-send README · 不打断你：| 场景 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 框内拖选 | 手势只在指针越出上边缘并达到 24px 后才武装，框内选择 100% 原生 |
| 空输入 / 发送按钮禁用 | 不武装，松手无事发生 |
| IME 组合中 | 组合一开始就取消手势，不会发出半截拼音 |
| 触屏 | 仅响应鼠标和笔，手指滚动永远不会误发 |
| 卡片上的按钮 / 链接 / 菜单 | 归它们自己，不会拉出消息 |
| 拖到窗口外松手 | 视为取消，不会误发 |

dsh-pull-to-send README · 动画参数：零构建、单文件 `client.js`，所有参数是文件顶部的具名常量（v1 没有设置面板）：

| 常量 | 默认 | 含义 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ARM_DISTANCE` | 24px | 越过输入框上边缘多少距离才武装 |
| `EDGE_MARGIN` | 8px | 可投放范围与窗口边缘之间保留的安全余量 |
| `DISARM_RETURN_MS` | 150ms | 拖回卡片内时副本的回位时长 |
| `HIT_PAD` | 12px | 卡片四周的隐形响应缓冲区 |
| `DAMPING` | 0.95 | 副本跟随指针的每帧插值系数（越大越跟手） |
| `MAX_SCALE` | 1.02 | 拎起时最大放大 |
| `FLIP_MS` | 400ms | 松手后副本飞入气泡的时长 |
| `BUBBLE_LEAD_MS` | 80ms | 真气泡提前淡入的提前量 |
| `RETURN_MS` | 200ms | 真输入框回位时长（不等飞行结束） |
| `CANCEL_MS` | 320ms | 取消回弹时长 |

dsh-pull-to-send README · 出问题怎么办：打开控制台输入：

```js
window.__DSH_PULLTOSEND__.disable()   // 立刻停用手势（不用重启、不用卸载）
window.__DSH_PULLTOSEND__.version     // 确认插件确实加载了
```

`disable()` 会摘掉全部监听器并把已拎起的副本收回；刷新页面即恢复。

dsh-pull-to-send README · 兼容性：同时兼容 claude-style 与原生界面（两者共用同一套 `data-composer-*` 锚点）；多个会话窗格各自绑定各自的手势。已验证发送路径：对发送按钮的程序化 `.click()` 在 React/Lexical 下真实触发发送（CDP 探针实测）。

锚点查找是三层降级：先找 `data-composer-*` 语义属性，找不到再按 `aria-label` / `contenteditable` 判断，最后才用类名模糊匹配 —— 任意一层命中都能工作。

dsh-pull-to-send README · PULLTOSEND：Press the DSH composer, pull upward, release — the message flies out. Keep holding to drag it back and cancel, or drag clear of the conversation to void it.

Three drags turn sending into muscle memory:

dsh-pull-to-send README · PULLTOSEND：- **Pull out to send** — drag up from the composer; the message hangs in the air, and letting go sends it.
- **Pull back to cancel** — change your mind and drag the pointer back into the composer; everything returns and the draft is still there.
- **Pull away to cancel** — fling it to the screen edge, the task bar or another window and the gesture is voided on the spot, never mis-sent.

[中文](./README.md)

dsh-pull-to-send README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "github:dhdkfkfkf/dsh-pull-to-send"
```

Restart DSH once after installing (adding the bundle itself needs a restart; code edits hot-reload via dsh-hmr afterwards).

dsh-pull-to-send README · The three drags：| What you do | What happens |
| --- | --- |
| **Pull out**: press the composer card (a 12px halo around it counts too), pull up past its top edge by **≥24px** | Armed: a clone of the input lifts off and follows the pointer (damped follow, slight scale-up, deeper shadow) while the real input shrinks and dims; hovering shows a grab cursor, dragging switches to grabbing |
| **Release** while armed | Fires the send control's current primary action (idle = send, generating = queue/steer); the clone FLIPs into the new message bubble with a crossfade |
| **Pull back**: drag the pointer back into the composer card while armed | Disarms: the clone returns in 150ms and vanishes, the card restores, the draft is untouched; pulling out again in the same press re-arms, so you can change your mind as often as you like |
| **Pull away**: drag the pointer out of the droppable area while armed | Cancels immediately: the clone springs back along its path, the cursor restores, this press is spent, releasing sends nothing, and a new drag has to start from the composer |
| Below threshold / horizontal-dominant drag / released inside the card / Esc / pointercanc

dsh-pull-to-send README · The droppable area：A release only sends when it lands inside this area:

| Edge | Where |
| --- | --- |
| Left | The composer card's left edge |
| Right | The conversation surface's right edge |
| Top | The top of the conversation area |
| Bottom | The composer card's top edge |

Anything outside is a cancel — the screen edge, the task bar, another application. To keep a pointer pinned to the screen edge detectable as "outside", the right edge is additionally inset by 8px.
dsh-pull-to-send README · The droppable area：No text prompts anywhere: the lifted clone itself is the armed signal.

dsh-pull-to-send README · Never interrupted：| Case | Why |
| --- | --- |
| Selecting text inside the box | The gesture arms only after the pointer passes the top edge by 24px; in-card selection stays 100% native |
| Empty draft / disabled send button | Never arms; releasing does nothing |
| IME composition in flight | The gesture cancels the moment composition starts; half-typed Pinyin never sends |
| Touch | Only mouse and pen respond; scrolling never accidentally sends |
| Buttons / links / menus on the card | Their presses are their own |
| Releasing outside the window | Treated as a cancel |
dsh-pull-to-send README · Tunables：Zero build, single-file `client.js`; every parameter is a named constant at the top of the file (v1 has no settings panel):

dsh-pull-to-send README · Tunables：| Constant | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ARM_DISTANCE` | 24px | Distance past the composer's top edge before arming |
| `EDGE_MARGIN` | 8px | Safety gap kept between the droppable area and the window edge |
| `DISARM_RETURN_MS` | 150ms | Clone return time when dragged back into the card |
| `HIT_PAD` | 12px | Invisible hit-area halo around the card |
| `DAMPING` | 0.95 | Per-frame follow factor of the clone toward the pointer (higher = tighter tracking) |
| `MAX_SCALE` | 1.02 | Clone scale at full lift |
| `FLIP_MS` | 400ms | Flight time of the send FLIP into the bubble |
| `BUBBLE_LEAD_MS` | 80ms | How early the real bubble fades in before landing |
| `RETURN_MS` | 200ms | Real composer return time (does not wait for the flight) |
| `CANCEL_MS` | 320ms | Cancel fly-back time |

dsh-pull-to-send README · If something goes wrong：In the console:

```js
window.__DSH_PULLTOSEND__.disable()   // stop the gesture now (no restart, no uninstall)
window.__DSH_PULLTOSEND__.version     // confirm the plugin is actually loaded
```

`disable()` removes every listener and puts back any lifted clone; reload the page to re-enable.

dsh-pull-to-send README · Compatibility：Works in both the claude-style and the native surface (they share the same `data-composer-*` anchors); embedded conversation panes each get their own gesture. The send path is verified: a programmatic `.click()` on the send button really sends under React/Lexical (measured with a CDP probe).

dsh-pull-to-send README · Compatibility：Anchor lookup degrades in three steps: the semantic `data-composer-*` attributes first, then `aria-label` / `contenteditable` heuristics, and only as a last resort fuzzy class matching — any single hit is enough to work.
